phrases.recover-whole-by-division: The known amount is already a percentage of the whole. Multiplying by the percentage again makes it smaller; recover the whole by division.
phrases.separate-delivery-method: Remove delivery before using the percentage Divide by the percentage multiplier to find the original.
phrases.identify-percentage: The item amount represents {percentage}% of the original. Keep any delivery charge separate.
phrases.avoid-forward-percentage: This applies a new percentage to the changed price. Instead identify the amount representing {percentage}% of the original.
phrases.separate-fixed-fee: Separate the fixed fee from the changed item price before identifying what represents 100%.
